translations.kjv: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
translations.ylt: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the choice sojourners of the dispersion of Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
translations.web: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

translations.kjv: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.
translations.ylt: according to a foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, to obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace be multiplied!
translations.web: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.

translations.kjv: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
translations.ylt: Blessed is the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who, according to the abundance of His kindness did beget us again to a living hope, through the rising again of Jesus Christ out of the dead,
translations.web: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

translations.kjv: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,
translations.ylt: to an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and unfading, reserved in the heavens for you,
translations.web: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,

translations.kjv: Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
translations.ylt: who, in the power of God are being guarded, through faith, unto salvation, ready to be revealed in the last time,
translations.web: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

translations.kjv: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations:
translations.ylt: in which ye are glad, a little now, if it be necessary, being made to sorrow in manifold trials,
translations.web: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved in various trials,

translations.kjv: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:
translations.ylt: that the proof of your faith--much more precious than of gold that is perishing, and through fire being approved--may be found to praise, and honour, and glory, in the revelation of Jesus Christ,
translations.web: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes, even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ—

translations.kjv: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
translations.ylt: whom, not having seen, ye love, in whom, now not seeing and believing, ye are glad with joy unspeakable and glorified,
translations.web: whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory,

translations.kjv: Receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.
translations.ylt: receiving the end of your faith--salvation of souls;
translations.web: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

translations.kjv: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:
translations.ylt: concerning which salvation seek out and search out did prophets who concerning the grace toward you did prophecy,
translations.web: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently. They prophesied of the grace that would come to you,

translations.kjv: Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.
translations.ylt: searching in regard to what or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ that was in them was manifesting, testifying beforehand the sufferings of Christ and the glory after these,
translations.web: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them pointed to when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow them.

translations.kjv: Unto whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto us they did minister the things, which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.
translations.ylt: to whom it was revealed, that not to themselves, but to us they were ministering these, which now were told to you (through those who did proclaim good news to you,) in the Holy Spirit sent from heaven, to which things messengers do desire to bend looking.
translations.web: To them it was revealed that they served not themselves, but you, in these things, which now have been announced to you through those who preached the Good News to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.

translations.kjv: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
translations.ylt: Wherefore having girded up the loins of your mind, being sober, hope perfectly upon the grace that is being brought to you in the revelation of Jesus Christ,
translations.web: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober, and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ—

translations.kjv: As obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:
translations.ylt: as obedient children, not fashioning yourselves to the former desires in your ignorance,
translations.web: as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,

translations.kjv: But as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conversation;
translations.ylt: but according as He who did call you is holy, ye also, become holy in all behaviour,
translations.web: but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior,

translations.kjv: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
translations.ylt: because it hath been written, `Become ye holy, because I am holy;'
translations.web: because it is written, “You shall be holy, for I am holy.”

translations.kjv: And if ye call on the Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man’s work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:
translations.ylt: and if on the Father ye do call, who without acceptance of persons is judging according to the work of each, in fear the time of your sojourn pass ye,
translations.web: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear,

translations.kjv: Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers;
translations.ylt: having known that, not with corruptible things--silver or gold--were ye redeemed from your foolish behaviour delivered by fathers,
translations.web: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things like silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,

translations.kjv: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:
translations.ylt: but with precious blood, as of a lamb unblemished and unspotted--Christ's--
translations.web: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,

translations.kjv: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,
translations.ylt: foreknown, indeed, before the foundation of the world, and manifested in the last times because of you,
translations.web: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in this last age for your sake,

translations.kjv: Who by him do believe in God, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.
translations.ylt: who through him do believe in God, who did raise out of the dead, and glory to him did give, so that your faith and hope may be in God.
translations.web: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope might be in God.

translations.kjv: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently:
translations.ylt: Your souls having purified in the obedience of the truth through the Spirit to brotherly love unfeigned, out of a pure heart one another love ye earnestly,
translations.web: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently,

translations.kjv: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.
translations.ylt: being begotten again, not out of seed corruptible, but incorruptible, through a word of God--living and remaining--to the age;
translations.web: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.

translations.kjv: For all flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower thereof falleth away:
translations.ylt: because all flesh is as grass, and all glory of man as flower of grass; wither did the grass, and the flower of it fell away,
translations.web: For, “All flesh is like grass, and all of man’s glory like the flower in the grass. The grass withers, and its flower falls;

translations.kjv: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.
translations.ylt: and the saying of the Lord doth remain--to the age; and this is the saying that was proclaimed good news to you.
translations.web: but the Lord’s word endures forever.” This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.

translations.kjv: Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,
translations.ylt: Having put aside, then, all evil, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envyings, and all evil speakings,
translations.web: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,

translations.kjv: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby:
translations.ylt: as new-born babes the word's pure milk desire ye, that in it ye may grow,
translations.web: as newborn babies, long for the pure spiritual milk, that with it you may grow,

translations.kjv: If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious.
translations.ylt: if so be ye did taste that the Lord is gracious,
translations.web: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious.

translations.kjv: To whom coming, as unto a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God, and precious,
translations.ylt: to whom coming--a living stone--by men, indeed, having been disapproved of, but with God choice, precious,
translations.web: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.

translations.kjv: Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.
translations.ylt: and ye yourselves, as living stones, are built up, a spiritual house, a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
translations.web: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

translations.kjv: Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture, Behold, I lay in Sion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded.
translations.ylt: Wherefore, also, it is contained in the Writing: `Lo, I lay in Zion a chief corner-stone, choice, precious, and he who is believing on him may not be put to shame;'
translations.web: Because it is contained in Scripture, “Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious. He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”

translations.kjv: Unto you therefore which believe he is precious: but unto them which be disobedient, the stone which the builders disallowed, the same is made the head of the corner,
translations.ylt: to you, then, who are believing is the preciousness; and to the unbelieving, a stone that the builders disapproved of, this one did become for the head of a corner,
translations.web: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient, “The stone which the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone,”

translations.kjv: And a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence, even to them which stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.
translations.ylt: and a stone of stumbling and a rock of offence--who are stumbling at the word, being unbelieving, --to which also they were set;
translations.web: and, “a stumbling stone and a rock of offense.” For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.

translations.kjv: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
translations.ylt: and ye are a choice race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people acquired, that the excellences ye may shew forth of Him who out of darkness did call you to His wondrous light;
translations.web: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.

translations.kjv: Which in time past were not a people, but are now the people of God: which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
translations.ylt: who were once not a people, and are now the people of God; who had not found kindness, and now have found kindness.
translations.web: In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

translations.kjv: Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
translations.ylt: Beloved, I call upon you, as strangers and sojourners, to keep from the fleshly desires, that war against the soul,
translations.web: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,

translations.kjv: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.
translations.ylt: having your behaviour among the nations right, that in that which they speak against you as evil-doers, of the good works having beheld, they may glorify God in a day of inspection.
translations.web: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good works and glorify God in the day of visitation.

translations.kjv: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;
translations.ylt: Be subject, then, to every human creation, because of the Lord, whether to a king, as the highest,
translations.web: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme,

translations.kjv: Or unto governors, as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers, and for the praise of them that do well.
translations.ylt: whether to governors, as to those sent through him, for punishment, indeed, of evil-doers, and a praise of those doing good;
translations.web: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.

translations.kjv: For so is the will of God, that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:
translations.ylt: because, so is the will of God, doing good, to put to silence the ignorance of the foolish men;
translations.web: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men.

translations.kjv: As free, and not using your liberty for a cloke of maliciousness, but as the servants of God.
translations.ylt: as free, and not having the freedom as the cloak of the evil, but as servants of God;
translations.web: Live as free people, yet not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.

translations.kjv: Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.
translations.ylt: to all give ye honour; the brotherhood love ye; God fear ye; the king honour ye.
translations.web: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

translations.kjv: Servants, be subject to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.
translations.ylt: The domestics! be subjecting yourselves in all fear to the masters, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the cross;
translations.web: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.

translations.kjv: For this is thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully.
translations.ylt: for this is gracious, if because of conscience toward God any one doth endure sorrows, suffering unrighteously;
translations.web: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.

translations.kjv: For what glory is it, if, when ye be buffeted for your faults, ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer for it, ye take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.
translations.ylt: for what renown is it, if sinning and being buffeted, ye do endure it? but if, doing good and suffering for it, ye do endure, this is gracious with God,
translations.web: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.

translations.kjv: For even hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps:
translations.ylt: for to this ye were called, because Christ also did suffer for you, leaving to you an example, that ye may follow his steps,
translations.web: For you were called to this, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,

translations.kjv: Who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:
translations.ylt: who did not commit sin, nor was guile found in his mouth,
translations.web: who didn’t sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”

translations.kjv: Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously:
translations.ylt: who being reviled--was not reviling again, suffering--was not threatening, and was committing himself to Him who is judging righteously,
translations.web: When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously.

translations.kjv: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed.
translations.ylt: who our sins himself did bear in his body, upon the tree, that to the sins having died, to the righteousness we may live; by whose stripes ye were healed,
translations.web: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were healed by his wounds.

translations.kjv: For ye were as sheep going astray; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.
translations.ylt: for ye were as sheep going astray, but ye turned back now to the shepherd and overseer of your souls.
translations.web: For you were going astray like sheep; but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

translations.kjv: Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;
translations.ylt: In like manner, the wives, be ye subject to your own husbands, that even if certain are disobedient to the word, through the conversation of the wives, without the word, they may be won,
translations.web: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands, so that, even if any don’t obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word,

translations.kjv: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear.
translations.ylt: having beheld your pure behaviour in fear,
translations.web: seeing your pure behavior in fear.

translations.kjv: Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;
translations.ylt: whose adorning--let it not be that which is outward, of plaiting of hair, and of putting around of things of gold, or of putting on of garments,
translations.web: Let your beauty come not from the outward adorning of braiding your hair, and of wearing gold ornaments or of putting on fine clothing,

translations.kjv: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.
translations.ylt: but--the hidden man of the heart, in the incorruptible thing of the meek and quiet spirit, which is, before God, of great price,
translations.web: but from the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious in God’s sight.

translations.kjv: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands:
translations.ylt: for thus once also the holy women who did hope on God, were adorning themselves, being subject to their own husbands,
translations.web: For this is how in the past the holy women who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands.

translations.kjv: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement.
translations.ylt: as Sarah was obedient to Abraham, calling him `sir,' of whom ye did become daughters, doing good, and not fearing any terror.
translations.web: So Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are if you do well and are not put in fear by any terror.

translations.kjv: Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.
translations.ylt: The husbands, in like manner, dwelling with them, according to knowledge, as to a weaker vessel--to the wife--imparting honour, as also being heirs together of the grace of life, that your prayers be not hindered.
translations.web: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman as to the weaker vessel, as also being joint heirs of the grace of life, that your prayers may not be hindered.

translations.kjv: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:
translations.ylt: And finally, being all of one mind, having fellow-feeling, loving as brethren, compassionate, courteous,
translations.web: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,

translations.kjv: Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that ye are thereunto called, that ye should inherit a blessing.
translations.ylt: not giving back evil for evil, or railing for railing, and on the contrary, blessing, having known that to this ye were called, that a blessing ye may inherit;
translations.web: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.

translations.kjv: For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:
translations.ylt: for `he who is willing to love life, and to see good days, let him guard his tongue from evil, and his lips--not to speak guile;
translations.web: For, “He who would love life and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit.

translations.kjv: Let him eschew evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and ensue it.
translations.ylt: let him turn aside from evil, and do good, let him seek peace and pursue it;
translations.web: Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.

translations.kjv: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil.
translations.ylt: because the eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, and His ears--to their supplication, and the face of the Lord is upon those doing evil;'
translations.web: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”

translations.kjv: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be followers of that which is good?
translations.ylt: and who is he who will be doing you evil, if of Him who is good ye may become imitators?
translations.web: Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?

translations.kjv: But and if ye suffer for righteousness’ sake, happy are ye: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;
translations.ylt: but if ye also should suffer because of righteousness, happy are ye! and of their fear be not afraid, nor be troubled,
translations.web: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled.”

translations.kjv: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
translations.ylt: and the Lord God sanctify in your hearts. And be ready always for defence to every one who is asking of you an account concerning the hope that is in you, with meekness and fear;
translations.web: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear,

translations.kjv: Having a good conscience; that, whereas they speak evil of you, as of evildoers, they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ.
translations.ylt: having a good conscience, that in that in which they speak against you as evil-doers, they may be ashamed who are traducing your good behaviour in Christ;
translations.web: having a good conscience. Thus, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ.

translations.kjv: For it is better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.
translations.ylt: for it is better doing good, if the will of God will it, to suffer, than doing evil;
translations.web: For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing what is right than for doing evil.

translations.kjv: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:
translations.ylt: because also Christ once for sin did suffer--righteous for unrighteous--that he might lead us to God, having been put to death indeed, in the flesh, and having been made alive in the spirit,
translations.web: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit,

translations.kjv: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;
translations.ylt: in which also to the spirits in prison having gone he did preach,
translations.web: in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,

translations.kjv: Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.
translations.ylt: who sometime disbelieved, when once the long-suffering of God did wait, in days of Noah--an ark being preparing--in which few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water;
translations.web: who before were disobedient when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.

translations.kjv: The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:
translations.ylt: also to which an antitype doth now save us--baptism, (not a putting away of the filth of flesh, but the question of a good conscience in regard to God,) through the rising again of Jesus Christ,
translations.web: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,

translations.kjv: Who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of God; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.
translations.ylt: who is at the right hand of God, having gone on to heaven--messengers, and authorities, and powers, having been subjected to him.
translations.web: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.

translations.kjv: Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;
translations.ylt: Christ, then, having suffered for us in the flesh, ye also with the same mind arm yourselves, because he who did suffer in the flesh hath done with sin,
translations.web: Therefore, since Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,

translations.kjv: That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.
translations.ylt: no more in the desires of men, but in the will of God, to live the rest of the time in the flesh;
translations.web: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.

translations.kjv: For the time past of our life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, and abominable idolatries:
translations.ylt: for sufficient to us is the past time of life the will of the nations to have wrought, having walked in lasciviousnesses, desires, excesses of wines, revellings, drinking-bouts, and unlawful idolatries,
translations.web: For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.

translations.kjv: Wherein they think it strange that ye run not with them to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:
translations.ylt: in which they think it strange--your not running with them to the same excess of dissoluteness, speaking evil,
translations.web: They think it is strange that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you.

translations.kjv: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.
translations.ylt: who shall give an account to Him who is ready to judge living and dead,
translations.web: They will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

translations.kjv: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
translations.ylt: for for this also to dead men was good news proclaimed, that they may be judged, indeed, according to men in the flesh, and may live according to God in the spirit.
translations.web: For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh, but live as to God in the spirit.

translations.kjv: But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.
translations.ylt: And of all things the end hath come nigh; be sober-minded, then, and watch unto the prayers,
translations.web: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.

translations.kjv: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.
translations.ylt: and, before all things, to one another having the earnest love, because the love shall cover a multitude of sins;
translations.web: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

translations.kjv: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.
translations.ylt: hospitable to one another, without murmuring;
translations.web: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.

translations.kjv: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.
translations.ylt: each, according as he received a gift, to one another ministering it, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God;
translations.web: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.

translations.kjv: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
translations.ylt: if any one doth speak--`as oracles of God;' if any one doth minister--`as of the ability which God doth supply;' that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom is the glory and the power--to the ages of the ages. Amen.
translations.web: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

translations.kjv: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:
translations.ylt: Beloved, think it not strange at the fiery suffering among you that is coming to try you, as if a strange thing were happening to you,
translations.web: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.

translations.kjv: But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ’s sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.
translations.ylt: but, according as ye have fellowship with the sufferings of the Christ, rejoice ye, that also in the revelation of his glory ye may rejoice--exulting;
translations.web: But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.

translations.kjv: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are ye; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.
translations.ylt: if ye be reproached in the name of Christ--happy are ye, because the Spirit of glory and of God upon you doth rest; in regard, indeed, to them, he is evil-spoken of, and in regard to you, he is glorified;
translations.web: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.

translations.kjv: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men’s matters.
translations.ylt: for let none of you suffer as a murderer, or thief, or evil-doer, or as an inspector into other men's matters;
translations.web: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men’s matters.

translations.kjv: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.
translations.ylt: and if as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; and let him glorify God in this respect;
translations.web: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.

translations.kjv: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God?
translations.ylt: because it is the time of the beginning of the judgment from the house of God, and if first from us, what the end of those disobedient to the good news of God?
translations.web: For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to those who don’t obey the Good News of God?

translations.kjv: And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?
translations.ylt: And if the righteous man is scarcely saved, the ungodly and sinner--where shall he appear?
translations.web: “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”

translations.kjv: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.
translations.ylt: so that also those suffering according to the will of god, as to a stedfast Creator, let them commit their own souls in good doing.
translations.web: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.

translations.kjv: The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:
translations.ylt: Elders who are among you, I exhort, who am a fellow-elder, and a witness of the sufferings of the Christ, and of the glory about to be revealed a partaker,
translations.web: Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed:

translations.kjv: Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;
translations.ylt: feed the flock of God that is among you, overseeing not constrainedly, but willingly, neither for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind,
translations.web: shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily; not for dishonest gain, but willingly;

translations.kjv: Neither as being lords over God’s heritage, but being ensamples to the flock.
translations.ylt: neither as exercising lordship over the heritages, but patterns becoming of the flock,
translations.web: not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.

translations.kjv: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.
translations.ylt: and at the manifestation of the chief Shepherd, ye shall receive the unfading crown of glory.
translations.web: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.

translations.kjv: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.
translations.ylt: In like manner, ye younger, be subject to elders, and all to one another subjecting yourselves; with humble-mindedness clothe yourselves, because God the proud doth resist, but to the humble He doth give grace;
translations.web: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

translations.kjv: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:
translations.ylt: be humbled, then, under the powerful hand of God, that you He may exalt in good time,
translations.web: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,

translations.kjv: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
translations.ylt: all your care having cast upon Him, because He careth for you.
translations.web: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

translations.kjv: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:
translations.ylt: Be sober, vigilant, because your opponent the devil, as a roaring lion, doth walk about, seeking whom he may swallow up,
translations.web: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.

translations.kjv: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.
translations.ylt: whom resist, stedfast in the faith, having known the same sufferings to your brotherhood in the world to be accomplished.
translations.web: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.

translations.kjv: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.
translations.ylt: And the God of all grace, who did call you to His age-during glory in Christ Jesus, having suffered a little, Himself make you perfect, establish, strengthen, settle you;
translations.web: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.

translations.kjv: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
translations.ylt: to Him is the glory, and the power--to the ages and the ages! Amen.
translations.web: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.

translations.kjv: By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand.
translations.ylt: Through Silvanus, to you the faithful brother, as I reckon, through few words I did write, exhorting and testifying this to be the true grace of God in which ye have stood.
translations.web: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.

translations.kjv: The church that is at Babylon, elected together with you, saluteth you; and so doth Marcus my son.
translations.ylt: Salute you doth the assembly in Babylon jointly elected, and Markus my son.
translations.web: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.

translations.kjv: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
translations.ylt: Salute ye one another in a kiss of love; peace to you all who are in Christ Jesus! Amen.
translations.web: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to all of you who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
